panels.name: Control Panel
panels.hint: The classic Control Panel.
panels.description: Opens the classic Control Panel home with every legacy applet.

panels.name: Network Connections
panels.hint: Adapters, their properties, IP settings and protocol bindings.
panels.description: Opens the classic Network Connections folder (adapter properties, IPv4/IPv6 settings, enable/disable).

panels.name: Power Options
panels.hint: Power plans and their advanced settings.
panels.description: Opens the classic power plan selector. iG Windows Tuner's power plan editor shows hidden processor settings too.

panels.name: Sound
panels.hint: Playback and recording devices, formats and exclusive mode.
panels.description: Opens the classic Sound dialog: default devices, sample rate and bit depth, exclusive mode and communications ducking.

panels.name: Mouse properties
panels.hint: Buttons, pointer speed and Enhance pointer precision.
panels.description: Opens the classic Mouse Properties dialog.

panels.name: System Properties
panels.hint: Computer name, performance options, page file, System Protection and environment variables.
panels.description: Opens System Properties (advanced settings, System Protection and restore points, startup and recovery).

panels.name: Region
panels.hint: Formats, location and the system locale for non-Unicode programs.
panels.description: Opens the classic Region dialog (formats, home location, administrative language settings).

panels.name: Date and Time
panels.hint: Time zone, additional clocks and internet time sync.
panels.description: Opens the classic Date and Time dialog with time zone, extra clocks and internet time.

panels.name: Programs and Features
panels.hint: Uninstall desktop programs and turn Windows features on or off.
panels.description: Opens the classic Programs and Features list.

panels.name: Windows Defender Firewall
panels.hint: Firewall status per network profile and allowed apps.
panels.description: Opens the classic Windows Defender Firewall page.

panels.name: Security and Maintenance
panels.hint: Security and maintenance messages, reliability and problem reports.
panels.description: Opens Security and Maintenance with security messages, maintenance status and problem reports.

panels.name: User Accounts (netplwiz)
panels.hint: Advanced user account management, including the sign-in requirement.
panels.description: Opens the advanced User Accounts dialog. Turning off "Users must enter a user name and password" weakens security; iG Windows Tuner does not automate sign-in.

panels.name: Device Manager
panels.hint: Devices, drivers, driver versions and device power management.
panels.description: Opens Device Manager to check drivers, driver versions and device power settings.

panels.name: Services
panels.hint: Windows services and their startup types.
panels.description: Opens the Services console. iG Windows Tuner's Manage > Services page adds safe-to-change ratings and snapshots.

panels.name: Event Viewer
panels.hint: Windows, application and security event logs.
panels.description: Opens Event Viewer with the Windows, application, security and Defender logs.

panels.name: Disk Management
panels.hint: Partitions, volumes and drive letters.
panels.description: Opens Disk Management. Changes here can destroy data; read each dialog carefully.

panels.name: Computer Management
panels.hint: Local users and groups, shared folders, storage and services in one console.
panels.description: Opens Computer Management (users and groups, shares, storage, services and logs).

panels.name: Local Group Policy Editor
panels.hint: Local Group Policy. Not available on Windows Home.
panels.description: Opens the Local Group Policy Editor. Policies set here override the matching iG Windows Tuner items, which then show "Managed by policy".

panels.name: Windows Firewall with Advanced Security
panels.hint: Inbound and outbound rules, connection security and monitoring.
panels.description: Opens the advanced firewall console with every inbound and outbound rule and its logging settings.

panels.name: Task Scheduler
panels.hint: Scheduled tasks and their history.
panels.description: Opens Task Scheduler with every scheduled task, its triggers and its run history.

panels.name: Resource Monitor
panels.hint: Live CPU, memory, disk and network use per process.
panels.description: Opens Resource Monitor to see which process uses CPU, memory, disk or network right now.

panels.name: Reliability Monitor
panels.hint: Crash and failure history by day.
panels.description: Opens Reliability Monitor. iG Windows Tuner's diagnostics read the same history.

panels.name: System Information
panels.hint: Hardware resources, components, drivers and the VBS status.
panels.description: Opens System Information (msinfo32): hardware, drivers, BIOS mode and the VBS status.

panels.name: System Restore
panels.hint: Roll Windows back to a restore point.
panels.description: Opens the System Restore wizard. iG Windows Tuner creates a restore point before every apply.

panels.name: Windows Update settings
panels.hint: Check for updates, pause updates and see update history.
panels.description: Opens Settings > Windows Update, where you can pause updates natively (iG Windows Tuner never disables updates).
